notes: TBox revision, stored (very_unlikely): the sum of two even numbers is a parity rule every model holds. Odd + odd was rejected because its subject would contain the new answer 'odd'; here the subject contains only the old answer 'even'. The three derived queries apply the edited rule to new members named in the prompt (inheritance, 2 hops), so every answer is determinate: two 50-digit even numbers, variables j and k (remainder mod 2) and two teams with an even number of players each (an application: pairing). A model could re-prove the rule from a = 2m, b = 2n; that is the rule itself, so it is what the edit has to overturn. The near query (two odd numbers) shares the relation and the form of the subject, does not follow from the edit, and its answer even differs from the new answer odd (Rule 7). Relation has_parity is functional.
